name: EPIC 228962976

text.card: A red giant 3,442 parsecs away, 27 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 10, give 1.25 solar masses and 27.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,387 K at its surface.
